capabilities.title: json_xs with documented options: JSON::XS commandline utility
capabilities.description: json_xs - JSON::XS commandline utility. Runs the program with options chosen by the caller from the 4 its documentation declares (pass them in "options", e.g. ["-v"]); undocumented options are refused. Option effects are declared by the documentation; see the card's evidence for those tested. Runs only in the sandbox.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Content given on standard input. Supply text to preserve its bytes; objects and arrays are serialized as JSON.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Documented options and their values, one item each: -v, -f <fromformat>, -t <toformat>, -e <code>

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: Named input files {"name.txt": "content"}: staged with exact flat names (no paths or leading dash). Options can refer to these names. All are operands unless "operands" selects otherwise.

inputs.name: operands
inputs.description: Names from "files" to append as positional operands, in this order. Omit for all files; [] for none. Auxiliary files used by options need not also be operands.
